summary: In tests from a small computer model rather than studies on humans, the drug received a medium risk score of 59 for the liver and a high risk score of 74 for the heart [M]. Warning labels report deadly or life-threatening heart muscle disease and irregular heartbeats, as well as permanent damage to the back of the eye that requires regular eye exams [3]. In addition, a clinical trial noted official recommendations against using the medication outside of a hospital or trial because of the danger of irregular heartbeats [5].
